name: XXE as SSRF: file proof -> error channel -> metadata creds
goal: Use XML entity expansion first as file-read proof, then as an HTTP client toward the cloud metadata service.
preconditions: Any XML parser accepting external entities: XML/DOCX/XLSX/SVG uploads, SAML consumers, RSS parsers, XML-RPC, config importers.
impact: Arbitrary local file read (configs, SSH keys) and, where the parser resolves http entities, cloud credentials via metadata.

steps.skill: web/XXE in-band external entity file read
steps.purpose: In-band proof: /etc/passwd rendered into the response confirms entity resolution.
steps.on_success: Read app config files next (paths from file listing) for secrets.
steps.on_fail: No in-band output -> step 2, use the error channel.

steps.purpose: Blind variant: exfiltrate file content through parser error messages.
steps.on_success: Same evidence, different channel — keep for parsers that suppress output but leak errors.
steps.on_fail: Errors sanitized -> OOB via canary DTD (documented gap: needs collaborator endpoint); meanwhile try metadata via step 3.

steps.purpose: Repoint the entity at http://169.254.169.254/... through the same parser (XXE-as-SSRF).
steps.on_success: Credentials JSON lands in-band or in error text; pivot to chain aws-imds-full-takeover.
steps.on_fail: Parser blocks http entities -> file:// read of ~/.aws/credentials, .env, /proc/self/environ instead.

recon.name: Content-Type probe
recon.how: Post the same entity payload with text/xml, application/xml, and inside an SVG; parsers differ by route.
recon.signal: Parser error mentioning XML = parse surface.

recon.name: Office-file steganography
recon.how: Inject DTD into [Content_Types].xml of a real DOCX and upload.
recon.signal: Upload accepted + entity resolved = stealth XXE on 'image/document only' endpoints.

recon.name: Parser fingerprint
recon.how: Error text identifies library (libxml2, javax.xml, php xml_parse) -> pick encoding/parameter-entity tricks per parser.
recon.signal: Library tells you which XXE bypasses apply (e.g. PHP param entities, Java jar://).

recon.name: OOB-free blind detection
recon.how: Time or size differentials from huge entity counts (billion laughs) confirm expansion without callbacks.

variants: Office macro-free xlsx with external references
pivot_hints: file read -> /etc/hostname + provider configs -> pick metadata variant
combine with path traversal skills once a file-read channel exists
